title: AI Trade Set To Bounce, SpaceX (SPCX) Surges, Netflix Tanks As Bond Auction Takes Center Stage
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: SpaceX earnings and data-center buildout plans soothe fears of an AI-trade collapse.
10-year yield setting up bear flag / head and shoulders toward 4.7%, but structural debt and sticky inflation mean yields will not return to COVID lows.

macro_themes.theme: Oil down, yields down, good earnings
macro_themes.view: That combination is a recipe for equity upside.

calls.condition: break above 7,719 (yesterday high pivot) for the next move up; turns bearish only if the ascending trend line breaks
calls.reason: Holding the ascending trend line on the daily; SpaceX earnings and falling oil support futures.
calls.quote: as long as we stay up in this range, I'm expecting the S&P to climb up to this level at around 8,000

calls.condition: only if it surges into the 171.85 gap fill / pivot top
calls.reason: Gap fill, pivot top and trend line confluence at 171.85; day trade only, not a swing.
calls.quote: if we get a surge up there, that is my short trade of the day on SpaceX

calls.condition: buy at the ~61.50 trend line / gap-fill confluence
calls.reason: Weak guidance broke the July 2026 pivot low, opening the trapdoor to ~61.50 where trend line and unfilled gap converge; day and swing long there.
calls.quote: For Netflix, this is both a day trade long and, in my humble opinion, a swing trade long as well

calls.condition: day-trade long if it drops into the gap-fill shelf
calls.reason: Gap fill with a shelf and secondary support below after the earnings drop.
calls.quote: Would I swing trade this level? I don't think so at this point. Probably just as a day trade today

calls.condition: head and shoulders must trigger by breaking the neckline
calls.reason: Bear flag and potential head and shoulders with measured target 4.7%, confluent with prior high pivots.
calls.quote: it's looking more and more like the 10-year yield's going to roll over and go to 4.7%

calls.condition: if it dumps on earnings, buy the ~650-665 zone
calls.reason: Gap fill at 665 and descending trend line into the 650 zone.
calls.quote: I'd probably be looking to buy a pullback into this level on earnings on Meta

calls.reason: First test just under 400 at the descending trend line; 350 the level to watch on a drop; expects at least a beat after SpaceX.
calls.quote: The big first test is going to be just under 400 at this descending trendline

calls.reason: Confirmed breakdown below trend line, which is now resistance; looks very weak despite falling yields.
calls.quote: gold right now is looking very, very weak

calls.condition: needs to recapture $60 to turn bullish
calls.quote: It would need to recapture $60 to start turning bullish

calls.reason: Six down days into longer-term ascending trend line near 2.73; added to his position on the breakdown into support.
calls.quote: I added to my position in nat gas on this breakdown into some decent support

calls.condition: if it rallies to 87,200 and breaks out, targets 95-97k
calls.reason: Hammered on the line and held, showing resilience.
calls.quote: if it breaks out, 95 to 97,000 is your upside target

notes: No date stated; listing 2026-10-21 used, but content (Meta/Tesla report after the bell today, SpaceX/Netflix yesterday) matches Sl2G2HnO2L8 (listed 10-22), so one of the two listing dates is off by a day. ES breakout spoken as "77 190" read as 7719.0. NFLX levels read as 61.50 per his "almost a dollar" gap description. AT&T levels unclear ("2113... 2191").
